stages.label: Brief
Script
stages.prompt: The brief for episode {slug} is approved. Build the research dossier, the long form script with Shorts, and the VO script. Save to episodes/{slug}/dossier.md, script.md and vo-script.md.

stages.label: Fact-check
stages.prompt: Fact-check episodes/{slug}/script.md. Save the report to episodes/{slug}/factcheck.md.

stages.label: Script fixes
stages.prompt: Apply every fix in episodes/{slug}/factcheck.md to episodes/{slug}/script.md and vo-script.md. List what you changed.

stages.label: Voice and edit
stages.description: Voice actor records vo-script.md. Editors and motion designers cut the video.

stages.label: Copy
stages.prompt: The script for episode {slug} is final. Write the YouTube title options, description, pinned comment, tags, and Shorts captions. Save to episodes/{slug}/copy.md.

stages.label: Social plan
stages.prompt: Copy for episode {slug} is approved. Adapt captions per platform, plan the posting calendar for the video and its Shorts, and suggest extra clips. Save the episode plan to episodes/{slug}/social.md.

stages.label: Publish
stages.description: Justine approves and publishes the video, Shorts and posts.
